subject.title: fix(msteams): reset sessions on app removal lifecycle

question: Should OpenClaw expose `resetSessionEntryLifecycle` as a supported Plugin SDK/runtime contract, including owner-coordinated locked-harness release, for channel lifecycle boundaries?
rationale: The Teams bug needs an atomic reset path, but adding this callable establishes a durable plugin API and cross-owner session-lifecycle policy that tests alone cannot define.

options.title: Adopt the scoped lifecycle-reset API
options.body: Approve the documented owner-scoped API and land the Teams fix with its compatibility and ownership tests.

options.title: Keep lifecycle reset core-private
options.body: Request a narrower core-owned seam or owner-plugin implementation so this behavior does not become a general Plugin SDK contract.

options.title: Defer the API direction
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers define the supported lifecycle-reset contract for harness-owned sessions.

recommendation.title: Adopt the scoped lifecycle-reset API
recommendation.body: Approve the documented owner-scoped API and land the Teams fix with its compatibility and ownership tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent direct work on the personal-chat reset scope and visible involvement in the PR make steipete the strongest available routing candidate for the API-direction choice.
